name: Repo Commands

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  commands:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event.issue.pull_request == null &&
      startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/')
    steps:
      - name: Check permissions
        id: check-permissions
        uses: actions-cool/check-user-permission@v2
        with:
          require: write
          username: ${{ github.event.comment.user.login }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Exit if insufficient permissions
        if: steps.check-permissions.outputs.require-result == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "User ${{ github.event.comment.user.login }} does not have write permissions."
          exit 1

      - name: Parse command
        id: parse-command
        run: |
          COMMENT_BODY="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          COMMAND=$(echo "$COMMENT_BODY" | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d '\r')
          echo "command=$COMMAND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Handle /makerelease
        if: steps.parse-command.outputs.command == '/makerelease'
        run: |
          echo "Triggering release process..."
          # In a real scenario, you would trigger a release workflow or script here.
          # For example, using the GitHub API to create a release or dispatching another workflow.
          # This is a placeholder for the actual release logic.
          echo "Release command received. Implement actual release logic here."
          exit 0

      - name: Handle unknown commands
        if: steps.parse-command.outputs.command != '/makerelease'
        run: |
          echo "Unknown command: ${{ steps.parse-command.outputs.command }}"
          exit 0
